summary: node1 now boots with audit=1 persistently. A controlled reboot changed the boot ID, the live kernel command line contains audit=1, and the kernel reports audit_enabled=1. The node recovered to a healthy running state.
actions_performed: Regenerated GRUB configuration and confirmed its boot entries contain audit=1.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Verified post-reboot system health, persistent configuration, live kernel command line, and kernel audit initialization.

evidence.summary: Shows the persistent GRUB source setting, successful GRUB regeneration, and generated Linux boot entries containing audit=1.
After reboot, /proc/cmdline contains audit=1; kernel logs report audit enabled and audit_enabled=1.

Baseline boot ID was dfeb3b70-bc1e-4ce9-90d0-9c9c853416e7; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 14ee3f35-514a-4364-a7fc-4493cba964e5. The system returned to running state with a writable root filesystem, persistent GRUB setting, live audit=1 command line, and active kernel auditing.
